LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_AutoCureMetalhorrorDesc: When enabled, instantly and painlessly wipes out Metalhorror parasite status from all colonists on the map.
LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_AutoVisitableEntitiesDe: When enabled, any hostile entity with invisibility status on the map will be immediately revealed.
LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_AutoPurgeFoodDesc: When enabled, automatically finds and destroys food items with anomaly contamination (e.g., Metalhorror contamination).
LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_MetalhorrorCured: Metalhorror inside {0} has been safely erased by the scanner.
LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_InvisibilityRemoved: OmniAutoDetector has removed suspected invisibility property: {0} ({1}) [{2}]
LanguageData.OmniAutoDetector_AutoDestroyPathogenicFo: When enabled, automatically finds and destroys items that may cause food poisoning (due to rot or incompetent cooking, etc.). If the stack is only partially pathogenic due to mod effects, only the pathogenic part will be destroyed.
